comment_regular: TESObjectREFR inventory count accessor: returns 0 when the reference has no container or no ContainerChanges; otherwise asks ContainerExtraData_GetItemCount(this, item), which combines base TESContainer count with EntryData.countDelta. Exact ABI is thiscall (TESObjectREFR *this, TESForm *item).
